#### Stand Up For The Weekend with Stephen Bailey & Guests Featuring Emma Coyne & Alex Mitchell plus compere Adam Beardsmore

##### Stand Up For The Weekend is our flagship weekly comedy show featuring top circuit headliners and guest acts plus incredibly funny and engaging comperes who host the show. A choice of table seats, reserved row seats and unreserved row seats are available to book online.

#### Headliner: STEPHEN BAILEY

The multi-award nominated Stephen Bailey is a comedian, presenter, actor and writer whose brand of gossipy humour has singled him out as one of the UK’s most sought-after talents, as well as boasting over 100k followers on Instagram after one of his videos was shared by none other than Melissa McCarthy.

Stephen’s quick-wit, playful sarcasm and enigmatic charm captivates audiences instantly. As well as being a prominent presence on the UK comedy circuit, he has also supported the biggest names in stand-up, including Micky Flanagan on his arena tour, Lucy Beaumont, Katherine Ryan, Jenny Eclair, Jason Manford, John Bishop and Sarah Millican.

Stephen is very much in demand and his numerous TV credits, let alone making a name for himself on Channel 5’s Celebs On The Farm, include hosting BBC’s Live at the Apollo and appearing on shows including Unbreakable, co-host on Date or Drop, alongside Amanda Holden, Would I Lie To You. Richard Osman’s House of Games, Celebrity Bridge of Lies and Celebrity Weakest Link, The Apprentice: You’re Fired, Between The Covers and Strictly: It Takes Two, and Pointless Celebrities. ​

events.description:
Brand new for 2026, Wild Lights will bring to life the beautiful features of Bristol
Zoo Project through an awe-inspiring display of light and sound.

Just 30 minutes from central Bristol, with easy access from the M5, meet friends and
family for a festive experience you won't forget.

Every evening from 27 November to 23 December, the zoo will transform into an
immersive winter lights experience to delight all ages. Follow the trail through
towering trees and along winding pathways, uncovering new surprises at every turn.
With bright spectacles, interactive elements and plenty of surprises, Wild Lights
offers something for everyone.

As you explore, enjoy warming drinks and festive treats, including black forest hot
chocolates, burgers and sausage rolls (veggie and vegan options available). Every
ticket sold supports our vital conservation work in the UK and around the world.

**Know before you go.** Please pre-book to guarantee entry and arrive no more than 15
minutes prior to your booked timeslot. We are a natural, outdoor site — some paths
are uneven and can get muddy in winter. Wild Lights is a winter lights trail rather
than a normal zoo visit: for animal welfare reasons the animals will be off show and
away from the lights, so to see them please book a standard day ticket in addition.
The first Wild Lights entrance slot is at 4.30pm and the trail finishes 1.5 hours
after the end of the last time slot. The trail is fully accessible, with wheelchairs
and mobility scooters available to borrow if booked in advance.

Bristol Zoological Society members are entitled to 20% off tickets on the first three
nights only. (The page states this twice and disagrees with itself on the weekdays —
"Friday 27, Saturday 28, and Sunday 29 November" in the body, "Thursday 27, Friday 28,
and Saturday 29 November" in the FAQ. 27 November 2026 is a Friday.)

events.title: New Bristol Sinfonia
events.raw:
Join New Bristol Sinfonia and the organists of Bristol Cathedral for a
spectacular evening celebrating the power, drama and beauty of music for
organ and orchestra.

Part of The Grand Organ Festival, this concert marks an exciting moment in
the life of the Cathedral's newly restored organ, bringing together
musicians from across Bristol for a performance of some of the most
inspiring works ever written for the instrument.

The evening opens with Widor's much-loved *Toccata*, the final piece played
on the organ before its restoration began. Audiences will then hear works by
Bach, Elgar and Poulenc before the concert culminates in Saint-Saëns'
magnificent *Symphony No. 3*, often known simply as the "Organ Symphony".

From moments of quiet reflection to thrilling orchestral grandeur, this
programme showcases the remarkable partnership between organ and orchestra
while celebrating the return of an instrument that has been at the heart of
Cathedral life for generations.

Presented by New Bristol Sinfonia and Bristol Cathedral as part of The Grand
Organ Festival.

Sat 28 Nov | 19:30 - 21:30
events.summary:
The Grand Organ Festival's centrepiece: New Bristol Sinfonia and the
cathedral organists together for Widor's Toccata — the last thing played
before the restoration began — then Bach, Elgar, Poulenc and the Saint-Saëns
Organ Symphony.

##### Stand Up For The Weekend is our flagship weekly comedy show featuring top circuit headliners and guest acts plus incredibly funny and engaging comperes who host the show. A choice of table seats, reserved row seats and unreserved row seats are available to book online.

#### Headliner: PIERRE NOVELLIE

Pierre Novellie is a stand-up comedian, writer, radio host and podcaster. He was co-host of The Frank Skinner Show on Absolute Radio, and TV appearances have included World’s Most Dangerous Roads (Dave), The Mash Report (BBC2), and Stand Up Central (Comedy Central). On the radio, Pierre has performed on The Now Show (Radio 4), hosts the BBC Sounds podcast series Obsessed With… SAS: Rogue Heroes and co-hosts the hit podcast Budpod with Phil Wang. As a writer, Pierre was one of the regular writers on the rebooted Spitting Image (ITV/Britbox) and has also written on shows including Mock the Week (BBC2), The News Quiz (Radio 4) and The Mash Report (BBC2).​

One of the UK’s most acclaimed live acts, Pierre‘s latest show Why Can’t I Just Enjoy Things? saw a sold-out run at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, and was his third show to have been placed in the top 20 best-reviewed comedy shows across the entire festival. His first special, Quiet Ones, was distributed by US comedy label 800 Pound Gorilla Records and has amassed over 250,000 views online.​

#### “*Dawn of a major talent*” The Guardian

#### ​”*A show packed full of belly laughs…impressively well written, perfectly building and building and rich with detail…Novellie delivers it all with real astuteness and skill*” The Metro​

#### “*A big presence…He will go far*” The Times

Discover Pierre Novellie here: [https://www.pierrenovellie.com/](https://www.pierrenovellie.com/)

events.summary: November's romance club leaves Prythian for Ali Hazelwood's The Love Hypothesis.
events.description:
**Whether you’re a fan of the series or looking to delve into romance fiction, our Romance book club offers a joyful escape. We're building a community to gush over swoon-worthy characters and a safe space to discuss themes like relationships. **

**In November, we will be looking at *The Love Hypothesis *by Ali Hazelwood. Let’s share the love!**

**Date:**
Monday 30th of November

**Venue:**
Max Minerva's, 47 Henleaze Road, BS9 4JU

**Time:**
Doors at 18:30. Discussion at 18:45. Finish at 19:45.

**Tickets:**
Attendance for the book club is free, but if you could register your place through the website, it helps us to gauge numbers.

If you would like to buy a copy of the book, you can order it through us and show up on the night.

**ABOUT *THE BOOK***

***The Love Hypothesis***

**When a fake relationship between scientists meets the irresistible force of attraction, it throws one woman’s carefully calculated theories on love into chaos.**

As a third-year Ph. D. candidate, Olive Smith doesn’t believe in lasting romantic relationships but her best friend does, and that’s what got her into this situation. Convincing Anh that Olive is on her way to a happily ever after was always going to be tough, scientists require proof. So, like any self-respecting woman, Olive panics and kisses the first man she sees.

That man is none other than Adam Carlsen, a young hotshot professor and well-known ass. Which is why Olive is positively floored when he agrees to keep her charade a secret and be her fake boyfriend. But when a big science conference goes haywire and Adam surprises her again with his unyielding support (and his unyielding abs), their little experiment feels dangerously close to combustion.

Olive soon discovers that the only thing more complicated than a hypothesis on love is putting her own heart under the microscope.

**ABOUT THE AUTHOR**

**Ali Hazelwood** is an Italian romance novelist and neuroscience professor based in the United States. Many of her works center on women in STEM fields and academia. Her debut novel, The Love Hypothesis, was a New York Times best seller and is currently being developed into a feature film.

University of Bristol.

Bristol Scholars programme — alongside the University's 150th anniversary —

**Comedy: Ian Stone IAN STONE IS LOOKING FOR THE WOW**

4 December · 20:00 – 22:00 · £22
events.summary: An extra show added for Ian Stone, whom The Times called a masterful exponent of self-mocking Jewish humour.
events.description:
#### EXTRA SHOW DUE TO POPULAR DEMAND

***“Life can’t just be the humdrum, the mundane and the routine before the inevitable slide to disease, decay and death. Why can’t we sneak in a bit of awesome, a tad of amazing and maybe a smidge of wonderful? A forest canopy opening onto a huge vista would be enchanting for some but my ancestors wandered in the desert for forty years, I think we’ve been outdoors enough. Others get their fix from the spiritual but I’ve been harbouring a grudge against God since my mother stopped me going to Arsenal after my Barmitzvah. Forty nine years ago. ’God will be watching’ she said. Well, at least he got to see the game. The point is, life could be so much better so I’m on the lookout. Come and join me on the hunt.”***

Ian Stone is a hugely experienced broadcaster, podcaster and writer and a brilliantly funny comedian. He performs at major comedy festivals and venues globally. His popular posts and reels on social media have quickly earned him a following of over 60k across BlueSky, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, amassing millions of views.

In the last three years, Ian has performed his one-man shows at the Edinburgh Festival to packed rooms and great reviews. In 2023, he won the prestigious Spirit of the Fringe Award. He took his last show on tour across the UK, finishing with a sold-out performance at London’s Comedy Store. Ian recently returned from making his debut at the Melbourne Comedy Festival. He will be returning to Edinburgh with Looking for the Wow before kicking off his UK tour.

Aside from stand-up comedy, Ian co-hosted the award-winning Rock ‘N’ Roll Football show on Absolute Radio for five years with Ian Wright. He currently presents a very popular (50k downloads per episode), twice-weekly Arsenal podcast, Handbrake Off, for The Athletic. A live version of the podcast recently sold out Leicester Square Theatre in London. Ian is also a regular contributor on Times Radio. His book To Be Someone was published in 2020 and has received nearly 500 four- and five-star reviews on Amazon.

#### Stand Up For The Weekend with Matt Stellingwerf, featuring Thor Stenhaug plus compere Jeremy Flynn

##### Stand Up For The Weekend is our weekly flagship comedy show featuring top circuit headliners and guest acts plus incredibly funny and engaging comperes who host the show. A choice of table seats, reserved row seats and unreserved row seats are available to book online.

#### Headliner: MATT STELLINGWERF

Matt Stellingwerf’s comedy blends sharp intellect with warm, conversational storytelling, drawing on his background in criminology, anthropology and life as a New Zealander navigating Britain. His style is thoughtful rather than confrontational, weaving research, personal anecdotes and audience interaction into routines that feel spontaneous, inclusive and quietly incisive. He tackles subjects from politics and psychology to relationships and human behaviour with self-deprecating wit and effortless charm.

Highly regarded by his peers, Matt Stellingwerf has won four NZ Comedy Guild Awards, including Best Newcomer. He is now UK based and respected nationwide by promoters and comedy venues.

A renowned MC and compere, Matt is a 3-time nominee for Best MC in New Zealand. Matt was a 2015 and 2016 nominee for the prestigious Billy T Award.

When this ***“erudite satire-superstar”* (Theatreview)** gets onto the stage, the acceleration from zero to a hundred jokes is measured in seconds. Matt Stellingwerf’s deftly crafted jokes display a man full of seriously good comedic talent.

#### “*Stellingwerf’s comedy is intelligent, clever and thoroughly researched..all of the while being really likeable*” Libel

events.description:
Ian Bagg is a world-touring comedian whose comedy was recently described as “dangerously flawless” on the JRE. But he is not just a comedian, he is also the co-host of the weekly hockey podcast, **Enjoying Orange Slices with Jeff and Ian**.

Early in his life, he discovered a love for hockey. Whether he was involved in minor, junior, pro, or friends getting together to play shinny, he loved hockey! He went to some camps and was cut, realizing he had no chance of making the pros. He knew it was time to use his natural talent to make people laugh.

Life has been fantastic for this energetic and wildly funny boundary-pushing entertainer. Touring nonstop across North America, he has started taking over the world with Australia, China, and the Middle East. With Europe being one of his latest stops. His fast-paced, off-the-cuff, quick-witted, animated style has him winning over television audiences.

He placed in the finals of NBC’s **Last Comic Standing**. He made appearances on **Late Night with Conan O’Brien** and **The Tonight Show.** A popular guest on WTF, YMH, a half-hour comedy featured on Comedy Central and HBO, not to mention one-hour specials on Showtime **Getting To Know You** and Amazon Prime **Conversations!**. His fast-paced multi-direction show has made patrons want to see multiple shows on a weekend. The audience becomes characters in his performance as they answer questions. Most comedians have a monologue; Ian has a dialogue. Attend a show immediately and see why his high school history teacher asked Ian’s parents if there was something he should know about Ian

events.description:
#### Stand Up For The Weekend with Dan Tiernan, featuring Joe Sutherland plus compere Ross Smith

##### Stand Up For The Weekend is our flagship weekly comedy show featuring top circuit headliners and guest acts plus incredibly funny and engaging comperes who host the show. A choice of table seats, reserved row seats and unreserved row seats are available to book online.

#### Headliner: DAN TIERNAN

Dan Tiernan’s comedy is a thrilling collision of anarchic physicality, razor-sharp writing and disarming vulnerability. He storms the stage with explosive, unpredictable energy, turning stories about addiction, neurodiversity, identity and working-class life into relentless laugh generators. His style veers from absurd one-liners to confessional storytelling, always delivered with a mischievous grin that makes chaos feel joyfully controlled. Critics have praised his ***“dynamic force”* (The Skinny)**, ***“unique ferocity… in utter command”* (Chortle)**, and ***“crude comedy with a big payoff” *(The Guardian)**. The result is exhilarating stand-up that feels dangerous, heartfelt and utterly original, leaving audiences laughing, wincing and wanting more.

Dan made a big impact on the UK comedy circuit back in 2022 after winning both the **BBC New Comedy Award **and the **British Comedian Of The Year**, and if this wasn’t enough he was winner of the **Best Newcomer at the ISH Comedy Awards** in 2023 and nominated for **Best Newcomer at the Edinburgh Festival** the same year. Since then, Dan has also been nominated for the **Next Big Thing** by the British Comedy Guide in 2025. With all of these accolades it does make you wonder where Dan can go from here.

Dan is hugely in demand and has performed at the **Melbourne Comedy Festival**, the **Cat Laughs Comedy Festival** in Ireland, and the **BBC Comedy Festival**, and has appeared on various radio and TV shows including **The Last Leg**, **Live At The Apollo**, **8 Out Of 10 Cats does Countdown**, and **The Stand Up Sketch Show**.

#### “*Raucously entertaining*” The Guardian

#### “*A furious yet friendly, thrilling rollercoaster ride*” The Telegraph

#### “*He’s a real force-of-nature comic who sweeps the room up in his exhilarating performance into a frenzy of laughter*” Chortle

**Comedy: Stand Up For The Weekend with Daliso Chaponda & Guests**

events.summary: Daliso Chaponda headlines the last club night before Christmas, on race, politics and growing up between cultures.
events.description:
#### Stand Up For The Weekend with Daliso Chaponda Featuring Erich McElroy plus Jeremy Flynn

##### Stand Up For The Weekend is our flagship weekly comedy show featuring top circuit headliners and guest acts plus incredibly funny and engaging comperes who host the show. A choice of table seats, reserved row seats and unreserved row seats are available to book online.

#### Headliner: DALISO CHAPONDA

Daliso Chaponda’s comedy blends razor-sharp wit, intelligent social commentary and warm, conversational storytelling. Drawing on his experiences of growing up between cultures, he tackles race, politics, identity and current affairs with playful curiosity rather than confrontation, delivering deft one-liners alongside thoughtful observations. His engaging, personable stage presence invites audiences to laugh while reconsidering familiar assumptions. As *Metro* observed, he is “**Full of sharp one-liners and well crafted gags… a real talent**,” while *The Guardian* praised his ability to “**Gets laughs out of topics other comedians shun**.” The result is comedy that is insightful, accessible, provocative and consistently entertaining.

Daliso Chaponda shot to fame in the UK on Britain’s Got Talent, making it to the final of the 2017 series and establishing himself a firm favourite with the judges and the British public. He became a Facebook and YouTube star amassing over 300 million views of his performances.

Daliso is also the writer, creator, and host of his Rose d’Or nominated BBC Radio 4 show Citizen of Nowhere that has aired for two series.

As seen and heard on The Royal Variety Performance 2020 (ITV), Britain’s Got Talent 2017 (ITV), Britain’s Got Talent Champions 2019 (ITV), QI (BBC2), The Apprentice: You’re Fired (BBC2), Good Evening Britain (ITV), The News Quiz (BBC Radio 4), and The Now Show (BBC Radio 4).

Discover Daliso Chaponda here: [DALISO CHAPONDA](https://dalisochaponda.com/)

address.street: Great Western Dockyard, Gas Ferry Road

events.raw:
19 December 2026

Take part in an exhilarating evening of entertainment on board the captivating SS Great
Britain
events.summary: A one-night murder mystery staged aboard the ship in the run-up to Christmas.
events.description:
Take part in an exhilarating evening of entertainment on board the captivating SS Great
Britain. During your dinner, keep your eyes open for clues as you become the detective and
help solve the mysterious crime. We offer guests the ultimate, memorable evening.

**The plot** — Introducing the strange case of Santa's 'Claws'…

Christmas 1937. Mr Uffton Harlecombe had just left the December meeting of the Board of
Governors at St David's School. However, there was very little 'Christmas cheer' at the
meeting this evening. In fact, as he pulled his thick coat tightly around him to shield him
from the silently falling snow, he smiled to himself. He had left no one at that meeting in
any doubt that crossing him was not a smart career move.

Still laughing to himself, he crossed the road and walked along the snow-covered side
street back to his Bentley Sports motor car. Everywhere was silent; a chill wind suddenly
picked up, making him huddle in a doorway to light his cigar. Perhaps he may have seen the
white-bearded face and the crimson costume for a fleeting second. Maybe he even saw the
weapon—a wicked steel claw!

Uffton Harlecombe had misjudged tonight's meeting. The information he had spilt to the
assembled people had been taken far more to heart than he could ever have imagined. One
person would make this a Christmas everyone wants to forget. The spirit of Christmas may
never die, but there are people here tonight who are going to do just that!!

**Key info** — Price: £99pp. Time: 6.30pm-12am. Includes: arrival drink, 3 course festive
menu & murder mystery experience. Group bookings: for tables of 8, contact
events@bristoldockyards.org.

events.summary: The Friends' Winter Lecture on Knepp, the Sussex estate whose rewilding became the reference case for the whole idea in Britain. No speaker is named on the index.
events.description:
Friends' Winter Lectures will take place on the third Thursday of the month at
the Frank Theatre, Wills Physics Laboratory, Tyndall Avenue, Bristol BS8 1TL
at 7:30pm. Lectures are free to Friends on production of their membership card,
and free to students on production of their student card. Guests who are not
members or students will be asked for a donation (suggested £5).

Speaker: Charlie Harpur, Head Gardener, Knepp Estate.

Charlie joined the Knepp team as Head Gardener in early 2022 to oversee the
rewilding of Knepp's Walled Garden, as well as the development of the Market
Garden and the landscape at the Wilding Kitchen. Having trained as an
architect, he worked for landscape architect Tom Stuart-Smith for several
years, then gained practical experience in horticulture and ecology at Chelsea
Physic Garden and Kew, where he completed the Kew Diploma in Horticulture.

**Comedy: Andrew Bird – BIRD ON EDGE**

25 February · 20:00 – 22:00 · £18
events.summary: Andrew Bird's new hour, on being permanently worried about everything from global events to parking.
events.description:
Back with a brand-new show Andrew Bird has just supported Russell Howard on his current national tour including four straight shows at The London Palladium. He has also recently supported Rhod Gilbert and Troy Hawke and at The UK Comedy Awards 2023 was voted Comic’s Comic-Best Act.

Andrew is always worried or stressed about something. From global events to finding free parking. From a wife hitting the perimenopause combined with two teenage kids, to hanging a wine-rack. How can he not be “on edge”?

Having previously supported Russell at Bristol’s Ashton Gate Football stadium he’s also supported Rob Brydon, America’s Brian Regan and Michelle Wolfe on their only London shows and Michael McIntyre on an entire arena tour including Wembley and the O2.

He was only 1 of 7 comedians to perform in front of Banksy at Dismal Land and he’s written on the recent series of 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown.

#### “*A brilliantly funny comedian*” Russell Howard

Travelling Light in partnership with Alibi present *The Forest Door*.

We are currently making plans and fundraising to tour the show to primary schools in Bristol, Bath and surrounding areas, plus Exeter and the South West in autumn 2027.

**About the show**

What happens when you go through a mysterious portal into another world? On the other side you find yourself in a magical forest, alive with wonder and excitement. Here, you'll meet other enchanting creatures preparing for a big festival… but there is a problem.

Join us on this brand-new adventure, as we explore traditions, memories and solve problems; resulting in one unforgettable celebration.

*The Forest Door* is a new theatre offer for primary aged children, incorporating performance, interactive in-classroom activities, and support and resources for teachers and families.

Grown from the imaginations of young people – The Forest Door is based on ideas from local children who took part in the development in Bristol and Exeter.

**Booking The Forest Door**

To place a booking request for autumn 2027, please complete our School Booking Request Form. Suitable for all primary aged children and their families aged 4-11 (targeted at Reception - Year 4). Performance: 50 mins. Full experience: 2 hours.

the Music List (there is a link at the bottom of this and every page) for
upcoming details of upcoming services, music, and who is singing.

the stated pattern does not cover.

events.title: All God's Children
events.raw:
All God's Children is an exhibition in Bristol Cathedral that explores the
impact of the slave economy on Cathedral life, past and present.

All God's Children is part of the Cathedral's work to understand its links
with the transatlantic trade of enslaved people. Research that informed the
exhibition discovered that between 1670 and 1900, roughly 1,000 people were
buried or memorialised in the Cathedral and its grounds. Around 200 (20%) of
them had a close connection to the slavery-based economy.

We hope that the exhibition will inform a wide-ranging conversation about
the stories we tell in the Cathedral, the ways in which we can repair and
restore damaged relationships and the ways we can work together for a better
future for everyone.

Listed daily at 10:00 - 16:00.
events.summary:
A standing exhibition on what the cathedral's own memorials record about
Bristol's slave economy: of roughly a thousand people buried or
memorialised here between 1670 and 1900, about a fifth had a close
connection to it. Open through the bank holiday Monday.

events.description:
We're proud of our beer and proud of the brewery in which we make it,
and gladly welcome groups into our "office" on guided tours of Bristol
Beer Factory.

It's a pleasure to open our doors again to reveal our BRAND NEW
BREWERY! After 20 years on North Street, we have simply outgrown our
tanks and are excited to brew in a sustainably focused site within the
same postcode. Our new brewery is located in the Ashton Gate Trading
Estate, the same distance to Ashton Gate Stadium as the Tap Room is,
just in the other direction! The address of our new brewery is 50-52
Ashton Vale Road, BS3 2HQ.

**About brewery tours.** Public brewery tours will be held every
Saturday throughout the year, with some exceptions over holiday dates
and additional weekday nights available. These tours are a great way
to learn about the brewing process and give an opportunity to answer
those burning questions you have about how your favourite drink is
made.

**What's included in the tour**

- 2 hour visit including tour of the Brewery
- 3 gluten free pints from freshly racked kegs
- 1x free pint and 10% off BBF products thereafter at the North Street
  Tap Room — head over after the tour to sample more beers or buy
  merch, cans, mini tins or growlers to take home.

**Private brewery tours.** We offer large groups (10+) the option to
have a private tour of the brewery. These are flexible and can be on
weeknight evenings or Saturdays at 12pm. Prices start from £300. Email
tours@bristolbeerfactory.co.uk to enquire.

**Vouchers.** There is no expiry date on the vouchers. If you have an
existing voucher for a tour or tasting bought before tours at the new
site were possible, get in touch to upgrade your ticket.

**Cancellations and rebooking.** Brewery tour tickets are
non-refundable, unless there are exceptional circumstances. Please let
us know at least 24 hours in advance if you are unable to attend your
booking and we will be happy to help you rebook for another date.
Tickets cannot be rescheduled with less than 24 hours notice.

events.description:
Each winter, we offer 1-day workshops teaching traditional hedgelaying: a craft
that preserves the past and protects the future. Courses are taught by
professional hedgelayers and accommodate all skill levels, from beginners to
experienced enthusiasts.

Hedgelaying involves partially severing the stem of the trees in the hedgerow,
allowing them to be laid at an angle of around 45 degrees. This fills gaps in
the hedge while encouraging new vertical shoot growth for denser coverage. The
laid hedge is secured with stakes and binding, varying by regional style.
Previously taught styles include North Somerset and Midland approaches, and
examples of the various techniques can be seen around the Grow Wilder site.

**Winter 2026/27 Dates To Be Announced.** "Future hedgelaying course dates will
be displayed in this section, once confirmed."

accessible toilet and baby changing available; assistance dogs only.

Our book clubs are genuinely our thing about Storysmith. We've held book

We like to read widely, so nothing is off limits — at the end of each

events.title: Foundations for the Future Exhibition
events.raw:
**Foundations for the Future Exhibition** — an exhibition celebrating
KWMC past and present. Everyone is welcome to pop in anytime Mon-Fri,
9:30am-5pm, in the Main Studio. KWMC, Leinster Avenue, South Bristol,
BS4 1NL.
events.summary: A free weekday-hours exhibition charting nearly thirty years of Knowle West Media Centre, with an open invitation to add your own stories to it. Call ahead — the Main Studio is also used for workshops.
events.description:
An exhibition celebrating KWMC past and present...

This exhibition charts almost thirty years of KWMC, exploring how ideas
have grown and the differences we have made together. At a pivotal
moment for KWMC, as our founder Carolyn Hassan retires, we look
backwards to go forwards.

We remember the social, political, environmental and economic backdrops
that shaped our work, reflect on the challenges faced and the insights
acquired. We see our history as 'usable past', providing rich
foundations for KWMC's growth into the future.

The exhibition is clustered around ideas of practice. In each cluster
you will find key activities and insights that help demonstrate these
ideas.

**What now?** Throughout 2025-26 there will be a series of events,
including reunions, in-conversations and workshops.

Fancy seeing the exhibition for yourself? Everyone is welcome to pop in
anytime Mon-Fri, 9:30am-5pm. The exhibition is set up in our Main
Studio space, which we also use for workshops or events. Give us a
quick call or email first if you'd like to check if the space is
available before arriving (enquiries@kwmc.org.uk / 0117 903 0444). Our
address is: KWMC, Leinster Avenue, South Bristol, BS4 1NL.

events.description:
## Discover Bristol's Vibrant Finzels Reach Market

Step into a world of incredible street food at Finzels Reach Market.

Open every Wednesday and Friday lunchtime, discover street food from around
the world.

## Our traders

Where would we be without our wonderful traders? Whilst some loyal traders
have been with us since the start; we're committed to keeping things exciting
by rotating traders each week and inviting guest traders to join us to bring
variety.

We rigorously vet our traders to not only ensure they're turning out the
tastiest street food but to check they are minimalizing food waste and using
eco-friendly packaging.

Want to know who's trading each week? Sign up to our weekly newsletter and
get details of who's trading each week into your in-box every Monday.

## History of Finzels Reach Market

Founded 9 years ago by Sophie Bowden and David Pyne, Finzels Reach Market
opened whilst Finzels Reach was still in development and has become part of
the make-up of this exciting and vibrant quarter. Located on a site which was
once the home to Courage Brewery and previously George's Brewery; the market
has gone through quite the journey. Having launched whilst the area was still
a building site; the market reopened during lockdown covid secure and has
since grown from a weekly market to a successful twice weekly market
showcasing over 40 different traders every month.

The market is carefully curated meaning traders change twice weekly resulting
in an ever-changing selection of street food on offer. Look out for guest
traders, seasonal food and themed markets.

## Visit us

A short walk from the city centre, Finzels Reach Market is located opposite
Castle Park surrounded by independent restaurants, cafes and bars and even
its own brewpub. Find the market located in Old Temple Street just off
Counterslip.

There are 3 routes into the market on foot, via Bath Street, Hawkins Lane
(over Castle Bridge) and Counterslip. Parking is available nearby at The
Galleries and Gardiner Haskins. There is free bike parking in and around
Finzels Reach, with major bike lanes along Counterslip. Many bus services
pass near the market, including the MetroBus. The market is only a 10 minute
walk from Bristol Temple Meads Station. Bristol Ferry runs a waterbus service
which stops at Castle Park jetty, just a minute's walk to the market.

## Frequently asked questions

**What sort of food can you expect at the market?** "With plently of options
for vegan, veggie and meat eaters; the market line-up changes twice weekly to
provide an ever-changing selection of top quality street food." From sushi,
deep fried chicken wings and Thai curry to Filipino spring rolls and Greek
gyros. "For those with a sweet tooth, we always have a cake stall!"

**How sustainable is the market?** "All of our traders use biodegradable
packaging and we don't allow any single use plastic." Customers are welcome
to bring their own lunchboxes.

**When is the market open?** "The market is open all year round on Wednesday
and Friday from 11am - 2pm. We are closed at Christmas, New Year and on Good
Friday. Please check our socials for the most up to date information about
whether the market is open as we always update there if we've had to cancel
the market because of challenging weather conditions."

**Are there toilet facilities?** "As an outdoor pop-up market, unfortunately
we're unable to provide toilets." Public toilets are available at the nearby
Galleries Shopping Centre.

**Do you cater for customers with food allergies?** "All traders have an
ingredient and allergen list available on their stall."

**Is the market family friendly?** "We welcome all customers to the market
whether you bring the kids or a furry friend."

events.description:
Located within Bristol's old city, St Nicholas Indoor Market is home to over
60 independent retailers that sell a mixture of gifts, original fashion and
hand-crafted accessories.

With three very unique areas of the market, why not make a day of it?

The Covered Market is home to a variety of self-contained businesses
including books, records and gifts whilst The Exchange Hall houses an
eclectic array of stalls from jewellery to hot sauce.

You're sure to find the perfect gifts for your loved ones at St Nicks.

Plus no visit to Bristol's most historic market would be complete without
visiting the Glass Arcade eateries for delicious food and drink.

**What you can find at the market**

With a wide range of unique stalls and shops, the thriving indoor market is
a great place to shop, eat and drink or just soak up the atmosphere.

The market is divided into three sections: Exchange Hall, Glass Arcade and
Covered Market. You can wander your way through the Covered Market which has
a series of individual shops through its quirky alleyways, or while away the
time in The Exchange Hall; a large open plan trading area with a broad
collection of items for sale. The Glass Arcade is home to a unique offering
of world foods so whatever your tastes, you're sure to find it here.

**Where it is:** Corn Street, Bristol BS1 1JQ

**When it is:** Monday to Saturday, 9.30am to 5pm

Make the most of your ticket by joining us at our daily talks & feeds to discover more
about the wonderful creatures of the deep. Ask us anything about your favourite animals!

**Daily talks & shows**

- **11:30am — Coral Seas** (Coral Seas): Meet the inhabitants of our colourful Coral
  Reef plus see how we train our rays and sharks.
- **12:30pm Mon/Wed/Fri — UK Fish and Sharks** (Ocean Floor): Discover more about the
  shark species that can be found around our own shores!
- **12:30pm Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun — Seahorses** (Learning Lab): Discover more about our
  graceful herd of Big Bellied Seahorses from Australasia.
- **1:30pm — Bay of Rays** (Rocky Shores): Meet our inquisitive rays and skates!
- **2:30pm — Amazing Amazon** (Amazing Amazon): Our turtles, pacu, catfish and more get
  their dinner in our Amazon river tank!
- **3:00pm — Octopus** (Ocean Floor): Learn about the incredible biology of octopuses as
  Mabel gets her dinner.

events.title: Go Aloft!
events.timesText: 10.15am–4.15pm, sessions roughly 30 minutes, two climbers at a time

address.street: Great Western Dockyard, Gas Ferry Road

price.text: £35.00 for the Go Aloft bundle (day pass + Go Aloft); from £24 for annual ticket holders

events.raw:
March – October 2026

**Go Aloft!** — Climb the SS Great Britain's rigging 25 metres into the sky, for the
ultimate birds-eye view of Bristol.
events.summary: Harnessed up the ship's rigging 25 metres above the dockyard, with the option of edging out nine metres over the dry dock — instructed by Young Bristol's outdoor employment trainees.
events.description:
**Master the climb** — Discover what it was like to be a Victorian sailor of the SS Great
Britain crew, and climb the ship's rigging 25 metres into the sky. Feeling even braver?
Edge out 9m over the Great Western Dockyard for hands down the best birds-eye view in
Bristol.

**The only way is up** — Each session lasts roughly 30 minutes and is limited to two
climbers at a time. You'll be guided through every step by trained instructors from Young
Bristol's Outdoor Employment Programme. We're proud to support the youth-driven charity in
its mission to help young locals develop leadership skills and gain nationally recognised
qualifications. They'll make sure you're safe at all times, in an experience we promise is
as authentic as the mid-19th century.

**Key info** — Time: 10.15am–4.15pm. Price: add Go Aloft when booking your General
Admission ticket; £35.00 for the Go Aloft bundle (day pass + Go Aloft), or from £24 per
participant for annual ticket holders. Suitable for families, 10 and over.

Booking in advance is required; there may be walk-up slots on the day for admission ticket
holders but this is not guaranteed, and a waiver form must be completed. Sensible clothing
and closed-toe shoes are required, long hair tied back, jewellery and scarves removed, and
loose items including mobile phones are not permitted on the climb. The full experience
typically lasts 20–30 minutes including the fitting of safety equipment. Climbs take place
in all conditions unless the weather poses a health and safety risk — generally winds
consistently above 20mph, gusts above 30mph, or lightning. Once booked, tickets are
non-transferable and cannot be rescheduled, refunded or cancelled.

events.raw:
**SS Great Britain experience** — Propelled by ideas since 1843.

Introducing our new museum: how many museums can claim they've travelled the world? Step
inside and discover interactive exhibitions, digital recreations, historic artefacts and
new community-led research uncovering voices and stories from SS Great Britain's 41 years
of service. Drawing on decades of research and the Brunel Institute's remarkable archive
of over 75,000 original drawings, letters and artefacts, the museum has been developed in
close collaboration with local community groups and researchers.
events.summary: The site's standing offer, expanded with a museum that opened in July 2026 — interactive exhibitions and community-led research alongside the ship itself, the dry dock, the Being Brunel museum and the historic dockyard.

events.summary: A free weekly 5km run around the Ashton Court estate, held every Saturday and open to anyone who has registered with parkrun. The council page states the distance, the weekly pattern and that it is free; it gives no start time or meeting point.
events.description:
### What is Ashton Court parkrun?

A free, fun, and friendly weekly 5k community event. Walk, jog, run, volunteer or
spectate – it's up to you!

### When is it?

Every Saturday at 9:00am.

### Where is it?

The event takes place at the Ashton Court Estate, just across the River Avon from Bristol
city centre.

### What does it cost to join in?

Nothing - it's free! but please register before you first come along. Only ever register
with parkrun once and don't forget to bring a scannable copy of your barcode. If you forget
it, you won't get a time.

### How fast do I have to be?

We all take part for our own enjoyment. Please come along and join in whatever your pace!

### We're friendly!

Please join us for a post run coffee at the Coach House Café in the courtyard of Ashton
Court mansion.

### What is Eastville junior parkrun?

A free, fun, and friendly **weekly** 2k event for juniors (4 to 14 year olds).

Nearby Saturday parkrun events can be found on the parkrun site.

### When is it?

It is held **every Sunday** at 9:00am.

### Where is it?

The event takes place in Eastville Park, Fishponds Road, Eastville, Bristol BS5 6PX.

### What does it cost to join in?

Nothing - it's free! but please register before you first come along. Only ever register
with parkrun once and don't forget to bring a scannable copy of your barcode. If you forget
it, you won't get a time.

### How fast do I have to be?

The aim is to have fun. Please come along and join in whatever your pace!
